resolvedDecisions.rationale: The reviewed source classifies the degree-zero 徐縣 spatial province as a modern-lake geometry defect, so the V3 route identity remains supply-protected without inventing an edge.
resolvedDecisions.resolution: RESOLVED_BY_GENERATOR_REPAIR (2026-09-16). The reviewed verdict — a geometry defect, not a real island — still stands, and this row was the protection that verdict bought while the defect was live. The defect is now repaired at its source: tools/scenario/build_han_world.py links a water-locked county to its own commandery seat, so 305 and 548 carry route edges and are no longer degree-zero in the city graph; dropping them from the protected set also lets tools/map/build_commandery_supply_links.py bake the 郡-internal supply edge it had been excluding (ADR-LITE-051). Both cities now read BOTH_SUPPLIED, so an active PROTECT row here would be stale. Kept verbatim as provenance — do not re-activate without re-establishing degree zero.
